# feint.tv — BRAWLVERSE

> BRAWLVERSE is an AI-generated virtual boxing league: 8 original fighter
> characters compete in cinematic bouts with trash talk, storylines, fan voting
> and free 1v1 Arena duels. All visuals are AI-generated and labeled AIGC.
> Site language: English (primary) + Chinese. Currency: USD.

## What is BRAWLVERSE

AI-generated virtual boxing entertainment league. 8 fighters: IRON JAW, VIPER,
SLEDGE, MONSOON, VOLT, THE PROFESSOR, LA REINA, GOLIATH-7. Season 1:
quarterfinals (QF1–QF4), semifinals, championship. Free to watch and free to
play: the Arena is a 1v1 tactical duel where each side secretly calls one move
per round. Accounts keep votes, fantasy picks and your Arena record; sign-in
via email, Google or GitHub.

## Arena duels

Pick any of the eight fighters, then call one move each round — strike, block,
feint, dodge or taunt. Stamina, hype and your rival's habits decide the
exchanges until one side is knocked out. Free, no account required, no
wagering, no real money, no cash prizes.

## Tickets & pricing (USD)

- FREE FAN $0 — watch free, browse, community, free Arena duels
- RINGSIDE $4.99/month — vote weight x3, early episode access, LED wall name
- BOOKER $14.99/month — vote weight x10, create props & stables, everything in RINGSIDE
- PROMOTER $49/month — vote weight x20, Booker Night invite, everything in BOOKER
- ANNUAL $199/year — everything in PROMOTER, billed yearly
- Monthly passes auto-renew, cancel anytime (effective end of period). No partial refunds.

## Refunds

Cancel anytime; access runs to end of billing period. Refunds only for:
duplicate charges, charges after cancellation took effect, or full-period
outages caused by us — request within 14 days via /contact. Virtual points are
never refundable.

## Support

In-site live chat (Tawk.to) or https://www.feint.tv/contact. Knowledge base
covers pricing, Arena rules, accounts, refunds, availability and creator perks.
